cases.name: DSSE PAE encodes UTF-8 byte lengths and exact payload bytes
valid Ed25519 DSSE receipt verifies against issuer and scope trust record
payload-byte tampering fails signature verification
payload-type substitution is rejected
signature-byte tampering fails verification
unknown keyid hint does not resolve to trusted authority
attacker signature cannot be relabeled with an allowed keyid
revoked signing key is rejected even when the signature is valid
key outside not-before/not-after interval is rejected
expired signing key is rejected even for an intact envelope
trusted key cannot sign for a tenant outside its trust scope
trusted key cannot sign for a source outside its trust scope
payload issuer must equal the registered key issuer
receipt tenant must equal the independently requested tenant
receipt source must equal the independently requested source
expired receipt is rejected after successful signature verification
future-issued or future-occurred receipt is rejected
malformed payload base64 is rejected before JSON parsing
malformed signature base64 is rejected
multiple signatures fail the single-signer profile closed
valid signature over non-JSON bytes is rejected before receipt use
revocation after the supplied verification time does not backdate key invalidity

limitations: Ephemeral test keypairs and an in-memory trust store; no root-of-trust provisioning, HSM, certificate transparency, production key rotation service or durable revocation feed.
Single-signer profile only. Multi-signer thresholds and cross-issuer consensus are not implemented.
This verifies payload integrity and configured issuer/tenant/source authorization at a supplied time; it does not prove the source event itself is truthful.
The test profile signs exact serialized JSON bytes and does not canonicalize JSON. Use RFC 8785/JCS only where semantic JSON equality across serializers is required.

source.qualification: Actual ephemeral Ed25519 sign/verify and in-memory trust-scope checks; not production PKI or a live-source qualification.
